project.name: Sylphx Verified Capabilities (open foundation)
project.summary: Open capability packages with contracts, qualification records, and outcome-receipt contracts for Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build; static install/sync runtime.

goals: Ship a semantic catalog of specialized requestable-job capability packages with progressive references and machine-readable capability contracts.
Keep always-on floors thin and miss-class-A only.
Install and sync capabilities for Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build from exact source revisions.

Record version-scoped qualification state per package (honest unqualified default); raise Trustworthy Job Coverage (Stage A Product North Star compass) and project Verified Capability Yield only when external outcome receipts exist (Stage B).
Enforce one engineering quality vocabulary (Quality North Star q-*, authoring-only—not product metrics) and one owner path per constraint pack.
nonGoals: Own live work, organization-wide adoption state, or outcome recording (user system / Control Plane).
Publish a policy encyclopedia as top-level listing skills.
Preserve obsolete listing-standard paths, methods bags, or dual-authority prose.
Hard-cap listing count for appearance; organize by requestable-job semantics only.
Claim qualification without version-scoped, expiring evidence from a named evaluator.
Fabricate outcome receipts or treat Quality North Star self-grades as Product North Star progress.

delivery.terminal: default-branch tree passes npm test; catalog digests match packages and carry per-package/repo-wide qualification state; every package has a schema-valid capability contract and qualification record; AutoSync promotion never downgrades qualified state; no dead listing-standard URLs in active skills
